hook: Your magnet can make a black liquid grow spikes.
title: Your Magnet Makes This Liquid Grow Spikes
description:
Ferrofluid is a liquid full of tiny magnetic particles. Bring a magnet close and it rises into spikes, then relaxes when the magnet moves away. NASA researchers developed it in the 1960s.

#Shorts #Science #Technology
comment_prompt: Would you touch it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your magnet can make a black liquid grow spikes.
scenes.headline: LIQUID WITH SPIKES

scenes.narration: Bring a magnet near, and spikes appear.
scenes.headline: MAGNET NEAR

scenes.narration: This black liquid is called ferrofluid.
scenes.headline: FERROFLUID

scenes.narration: It is oil full of tiny magnetic particles.
scenes.headline: TINY MAGNETS INSIDE

scenes.narration: The magnet pulls every particle toward it.
scenes.headline: PULLED TOGETHER

scenes.narration: Together they form a spiky crown.
scenes.headline: SPIKY CROWN

scenes.narration: Remove the magnet and the spikes melt away.
scenes.headline: SPIKES MELT AWAY

scenes.narration: NASA researchers invented it in the 1960s.
scenes.headline: NASA MADE IT

scenes.narration: So yes, a liquid really grows spikes.
scenes.headline: TOTALLY REAL

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a German town inside Switzerland.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
